clinician.trajectory_summary: A female patient in her 60s presented with a vulvar mass on the left labium minus. An initial excisional biopsy (E001) revealed a 32 mm nodule with cribriform and papillary architecture, moderate cytological atypia, and a high mitotic index. Immunohistochemistry (IHC) on this initial biopsy (E002) showed positivity for ER (90-100%), CK7, CAM5.2, and GATA3, and negativity for PR, GCDFP-15, SOX10, p63, and CK20, with equivocal HER-2 (2+) and negative FISH for amplification. Staging investigations included clinical examination, breast ultrasound, mammography, chest CT, and gastrointestinal tract study, all reported as normal (E003). A whole-body PET scan (E003) showed no additional hypermetabolic lesions beyond the vulvar mass.
